title.narrative: Technical Assistance for the DAMU Green Loan for SMEs

description.narrative: The objective is to promote local private sector clean development, and consequently generate local incomes and employment, while contributing to abate, mitigate, compensate and adapt to climate change related issues.The objective is to be achieved by:Providing access to long term finance to local SMEs and MidCapsEnabling local financial institutions to provide long term finance to SMEs and MidCapsEstablishing environmentally sustainable best practices at SME and MidCaps level
